faqs.question: VPN is not connecting. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Restart the VPN client, check your internet, and make sure your password has not expired. If the VPN is down for many users, the IT Service Desk will post an update on the status page.

faqs.question: My laptop is very slow.
faqs.answer: Restart the laptop, close unused applications and let pending updates finish. If it is still slow, raise a ticket so IT can check the disk and memory.

faqs.question: Outlook is not syncing emails.
faqs.answer: Check your internet connection, restart Outlook, and use File > Account Settings > Repair. Webmail can be used meanwhile.

faqs.question: How do I get software installed?
faqs.answer: Request approved software from the Software Center. For software not listed, raise a ticket with the name, version and project need; installation takes 1-2 working days.

faqs.question: The printer is not working.
faqs.answer: Check that the printer is online and has paper, then remove and re-add it under Settings > Printers. Report hardware faults to the IT Service Desk.

faqs.question: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting.
faqs.answer: Forget the network and reconnect using your office login. If the problem is in one room only, report the room number so IT can check the access point.

faqs.question: How do I reset my LMS or portal password?
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes; check your spam folder.

faqs.question: My account is locked.
faqs.answer: Accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes, or immediately after a self-service password reset.

faqs.question: How do I request access to GitHub, Jira or other tools?
faqs.answer: Raise an access request with the tool name and your manager's approval. Access is usually granted within 1 working day.

faqs.question: How are accounts set up for a new joiner?
faqs.answer: The manager submits the onboarding form at least 3 working days before the joining date. Email, LMS and laptop login are ready on day one.

faqs.question: I lost the phone with my MFA authenticator.
faqs.answer: Contact the Identity & Access Team with your employee ID. After identity verification, MFA is reset and you can register a new device.

faqs.question: My password expired.
faqs.answer: Use self-service password reset from the login page or the office network. The new password works on VPN after about 15 minutes.

faqs.question: Course videos are not loading in the LMS.
faqs.answer: Clear the browser cache, try another browser, and check that your internet speed is at least 5 Mbps. Report the module name if one video fails for everyone.

faqs.question: When will I get my course certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificates are issued within 7 working days after all assessments are passed. Download it from LMS > My Certificates.

faqs.question: Can I change my batch timing?
faqs.answer: Batch changes are allowed once per course, subject to seat availability. Request it from LMS > My Courses > Change Batch.

faqs.question: How do I enroll in a course?
faqs.answer: Choose the course on the training portal, select a batch and complete the payment. You get LMS access within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Where can I find session recordings?
faqs.answer: Recordings are uploaded to the course page in the LMS within 24 hours after each live session.

faqs.question: The exam or assessment portal is not opening.
faqs.answer: Use Chrome, clear the cache and disable pop-up blockers. If the portal does not open 15 minutes before the exam, contact your trainer so the exam can be rescheduled.

faqs.question: When is salary credited?
faqs.answer: Salary is credited on the last working day of the month. If it is not received by the 3rd of the next month, raise a ticket with HR.

faqs.question: How do I apply for leave or check its status?
faqs.answer: Apply in the HR portal under Leave. Your manager approves it; pending requests can be followed up with your manager.

faqs.question: How do I get an experience letter?
faqs.answer: Request it in the HR portal under Letters. Letters are issued within 5 working days.

faqs.question: I lost my ID card.
faqs.answer: Report the loss to Admin and apply for a replacement in the HR portal. A replacement card is ready in 3 working days.

faqs.question: I cannot download my payslip.
faqs.answer: Payslips are in HR portal > Payroll > Payslips. Use Chrome and allow pop-ups; payslips are published on the 2nd of each month.

faqs.question: How do I claim reimbursement?
faqs.answer: Submit claims with bills in the HR portal within 30 days. Approved claims are paid with the next salary.

faqs.question: How do I get a fee receipt or GST invoice?
faqs.answer: Download receipts from the training portal under Payments. Add your GSTIN before payment to get a GST invoice.

faqs.question: I was charged twice for my fee.
faqs.answer: Duplicate payments are refunded within 5-7 working days after verification. Share both transaction IDs in the ticket.

faqs.question: Payment failed but money was deducted.
faqs.answer: Failed payments are reversed by the bank within 5-7 working days. Share the transaction ID if it is not reversed.

faqs.question: When will I get a refund for a cancelled course?
faqs.answer: Refunds for cancellations within the allowed period are processed within 10 working days to the original payment method.

faqs.question: Is EMI available for course fees?
faqs.answer: EMI is available for courses above 20,000 through partner banks. Select EMI at checkout.

faqs.question: How do I change the billing address on invoices?
faqs.answer: Update the billing address in the portal under Company Profile. New invoices use the updated address.
